title: Nested if with elif inside
idea: The inner decision can itself be an if/elif/else chain, giving several inner outcomes once the outer gate is passed. Predict output.

exercises.prompt: Can the inner decision be an if / elif / else chain instead of just if / else?
options: Yes - any decision can go inside the outer body, including an elif chain
No - only a single if is allowed inside
Only if there is no outer else
exercises.explanation: Whatever you can write at the top level you can write indented inside a branch, including a full if/elif/else chain.
logged_in is True, so we enter. role == 1 is False, role == 2 is True, so 'Editor'.

exercises.prompt: Same code, logged_in = True, role = 5. What prints?
exercises.explanation: Inside the logged-in branch, role 5 matches neither 1 nor 2, so the inner else runs: 'Viewer'.

exercises.prompt: Same code, logged_in = False, role = 1. What prints?
exercises.explanation: The outer if is False, so the whole role chain is skipped and the outer else runs: 'Log in first'.

exercises.prompt: The inner elif chain is only considered when the outer condition is True.
exercises.explanation: Yes. The chain lives inside the outer body, so it is reached only after the outer gate is passed.

exercises.prompt: Arrange: once a user is active, grade them A/B/C by score.
exercises.explanation: The whole grading chain is indented inside the 'active' branch, so grading only happens for active users.
elif adds a middle outcome. It is checked only when the 90 test above it was False - and only when 'active' let us in.
active is True; 85 >= 90 is False; 85 >= 80 is True, so the elif runs: 'B'.

exercises.prompt: How many outcomes does this structure have: outer if/else, with an inner if/elif/else inside the if?
options: Four - three from the inner chain plus the outer else
exercises.explanation: Inner chain gives A, B, C (three). The outer else gives a fourth. Nesting multiplies the paths.

exercises.prompt: When does putting an elif chain inside an if make sense?
options: When several buckets only apply after an outer gate is passed
Only when there is no else
exercises.explanation: Nest a chain when the bucket question only matters once an outer condition holds - like grading only active users.
